description: Land Acquisition - Moonrumurippu, Vavuniya D/S Division, Vavuniya District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (0.4047 hectares) for the public purpose of constructing a brigade headquarters. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, including the land's description, location, purpose of acquisition, and procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
